correctness.rationale: Midpoint Spoiler strategy with t=2^(q-1)-1 splits a shorter/equal pair into differing subwords each of size <=t, so induction separates all different coloured words <=2^q-1, including empty and q=1. Finite Boolean combinations of separating formulas preserve rank and decide any restriction of a language. Duplicator responds in monochromatic lengths >=2^q-1 by maintaining short-equal or long-long gaps; that yields adjacent opposite-parity unary witnesses inside every horizon and lower bound. Independently recreated recursive colored rank types and confirmed short-word injectivity for q=1,2,3 on all binary words; this finite check is not a general proof.
residual_risks: Source analytical argument is necessary for infinite parameters; independent finite/symbolic checks establish only stated identities and finite ranges.
